idea: Phone War Room: mobile layout, dark mode, big status chips, and a New pick form usable on an iPhone

report.restatement: Make the War Room work on Boyd's iPhone (390×844 CSS px, also 430×932), in light and dark. On the Big Board and every pick page, nothing should scroll sideways, every tap target should be at least 44×44, status chips should be big enough to read at arm's length, and nothing should be lost while he submits an idea. Today's War Room is dark-only, built for desktop, and scrolls 61 px sideways at 390 px. Add pick is 95×35, the status chips are 12 px text in a 22.8 px pill, and the New pick form loses its status (and, on a failed submit, the idea) the moment a live update redraws the page.

acceptance.when: src/ui/index.html is read
acceptance.shall: have viewport content exactly width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover (no maximum-scale, no user-scalable), <meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">, and two theme-color metas with media="(prefers-color-scheme: light)" = the light --bg and media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" = #12160f. (Baseline: 4 problems.)

acceptance.when: src/ui/styles.css is parsed
acceptance.shall: open with the light :root block (color-scheme: light dark plus the 25 tokens of T1) followed by @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root { … } } holding the same 25 tokens, every value #rrggbb, no other declarations. (Baseline: 52 problems; 10 tokens in light, dark block absent.)

acceptance.when: each contrast pair in the table is computed in both schemes
acceptance.shall: meet its minimum; the dark ratios equal the pinned column to two decimals.

acceptance.when: the dark block is read
acceptance.shall: equal T2's 24 pinned values exactly.

acceptance.when: styles.css outside the two token blocks, timeline.css, and in Mode S lessons.css are scanned
acceptance.shall: find no color literal per T4. (Baseline: 13, which is 12 in styles.css and 1 in timeline.css. Mode S at START e242a53 (draft PR #5) adds 2 lessons.css literals, .dd-level #24364a and .dd-lessons .dd-first #24301c, so the token check finds 82 with lessons.css included. Neither is a new token: T1 stays at 25, so map #24364a to var(--chip-review-bg) and #24301c to an existing token such as var(--glow) or var(--card).)

acceptance.when: each of the ten statuses is resolved through the top-level .chip rules
acceptance.shall: land on its family's background and ink tokens from the status-family table. (Baseline: 10 wrong, all literals.)

acceptance.when: the Big Board (board-states.json served, or the verify data dir) and a pick page are open at 390×844 and 430×932 in light and dark
acceptance.shall: not scroll sideways: probe scrollWidth ≤ the viewport width (baseline Big Board: 451 at both widths), with the 141-character idea wrapping.

acceptance.when: those pages are probed
acceptance.shall: give every visible a[href], button, input, select, textarea, summary and [role=button] a box of at least 44×44 (inline links inside a Decision log sentence, .dd-event, are exempt) and every field a computed font size of at least 16 px. (Baseline: Add pick 95×35 on the Big Board, Big Board 74×22 on a pick page, and in Mode S Locker Room 98×22.)

acceptance.when: those pages are probed at 480 px or narrower
acceptance.shall: render every .chip, including one synthetic chip per status made with chip(status), at a font size of at least 16 px and at least 32 px tall, with ink/background contrast of at least 4.5, and with text equal to the status. (Baseline: 12 px / 22.8 px; 20 problems on the Big Board, 11 on a pick page.)

acceptance.when: the page is laid out
acceptance.shall: keep h1 and every .panel at least 12 px from both viewport edges, and styles.css SHALL pad .top and main with env(safe-area-inset-left) / env(safe-area-inset-right) (inside max() with a 16 px floor is fine). (Baseline: no env() anywhere.)

acceptance.when: the Big Board renders board-states.json in the harness
acceptance.shall: still build one table with tbody#board-body, headers Pick, Idea, Stage, Status, Runs, exactly 10 rows (9 picks then 1 inbox row) of exactly five cells, pick rows carrying data-pick-id in API order with a first link #/picks/<id>; AND no src/ui/*.js reads the viewport (matchMedia, innerWidth, outerWidth, innerHeight, visualViewport, screen., resize, orientationchange). Phone layout is CSS only. (Baseline: passes; it must keep passing.)

acceptance.when: the Big Board is open
acceptance.shall: show the New pick form exactly as in "The New pick form" (names, textarea, the four Target attributes, Candidates 1-5 value 3 with inputmode="numeric" or a select, type="submit", one role="status"). (Baseline: 5/7; the Target attributes and inputmode are missing.)

acceptance.when: Add pick is submitted once
acceptance.shall: make exactly one POST /api/intake, content-type: application/json, with exactly the four-key body, and only GET /api/board after it.

acceptance.when: a submit is in flight
acceptance.shall: disable Add pick, show Sending…, and send nothing for further submits, including after a full redraw by a live update with nothing focused; WHEN the answer lands after that redraw THE SYSTEM SHALL show the outcome on the form now on screen and enable Add pick. (Baseline: 2/7; a second submit in flight sends a second POST.)

acceptance.when: the answer is ok, policy, error, rejected, or non-JSON
acceptance.shall: show the status sentence from the outcome table, clear or keep the idea per that table, and enable Add pick, with no unhandled promise rejection; WHEN the error string is THE SYSTEM SHALL show it literally, create no img, script or iframe node and set no on* attribute. (Baseline: 15/19; rejected and non-JSON leave Sending… and throw.)

acceptance.when: a full redraw happens after an outcome with nothing focused (iOS Safari after a tap)
acceptance.shall: keep the status sentence and, for error and failure outcomes, the submitted idea; a resubmit from the redrawn form SHALL send that idea. (Baseline: 0/6.)

acceptance.when: the page runs
acceptance.shall: request only same-origin /api/board, /api/intake, /api/picks/<id> and /api/lessons… through fetch, open exactly one EventSource on /api/events, and, in Chrome, load no resource from another origin (probe offOrigin is [], no W17 problem).

acceptance.when: in Mode S
acceptance.shall: also pass W5 with lessons.css included and W7-W9 on #/lessons?since=2026-10-11&until=2026-10-16 at both sizes and schemes, by editing lessons.css only (baseline at START e242a53, all four size/scheme runs: W8 30 + W9 10, where W9 10 is the synthetic chip row and W8 is Big Board, Show, Clear 38×35 and the receipt id links; with the box reference's styles.css alone the Locker Room passes W7-W9 with 0 problems, so the lessons.css phone block is optional and only its 2 color literals must change). WHEN in Mode F THE SYSTEM SHALL have no Pick 3 lane path in git diff --name-only START...HEAD.

acceptance.when: npm test runs after this change
acceptance.shall: still pass every earlier test (SPEC 001 A1-A15, Picks 1-3 suites, the import boundary, the network grep, T18) with test/guards.test.ts byte-identical, zero runtime dependencies, src/server/http.ts unchanged, the five uploads byte-identical (sha256 above), dd selftest printing its happy, policy, walkover and close lines unchanged, and git diff --name-only START...HEAD inside the touch map.

acceptance.when: the verify skill's features/phone.md is driven
acceptance.shall: produce the eight phone screenshots (VERIFY 6) plus phone-form-sending.png and phone-form-kept.png, and the 1280×800 Big Board SHALL still show the five-column table.

rubric.name: Thumb-reach layout
rubric.howToGrade: Run cdp-shot.mjs on the Big Board and the close pick's page at 390×844 and 430×932 in light and dark (8 runs; Mode S adds #/lessons?since=2026-10-11&until=2026-10-16, 4 more). 4 = every probe ok: true and, from the 390 screenshots, you can say within 5 seconds which picks are drafted, which failed and where Add pick is. 3 = probes pass but one screen is cramped or truncates an idea. 2 = one W7/W8/W9 problem left. 0 = sideways scroll on the Big Board at 390. The 1280×800 Big Board must still be a readable five-column table; a broken desktop layout caps this at 1. Screenshots are required for a 3 or 4.

rubric.name: Two-scheme token discipline
rubric.howToGrade: Your pooled W1-W6 and W10 pass. Grep the diff's added lines in src/ui/*.css for hex colors and color functions outside the two token blocks, and for any [data-status= rule that sets a color other than a family token. Compare the dark screenshots with the same pages at START (git worktree add /tmp/start START): colors must match, only sizes may move. A second token set (a .light class, a duplicated block under another selector), a JavaScript theme switch, or a stored preference = 0. A light pair below 4.5:1 caps this at 1.

rubric.name: Intake form resilience
rubric.howToGrade: Your pooled W12-W17. Then by hand in the harness: submit, emit two updates, blur, settle with a 500 {error}, and check that the status, the kept idea and an enabled Add pick are all on the redrawn form. Submit 3 times in one tick: one POST. Make fetch reject: no unhandled rejection. Each status sentence exact. One sentence that differs from the table, or one path that leaves Sending… forever = 1 at most.

rubric.name: Same-origin, text-only safety
rubric.howToGrade: Re-run the safety-fact proof with your own hostile values: an error of "> and an error of 2,000 characters with no spaces (it must wrap: probe W7 with it shown). Grep src/ui for innerHTML, outerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, document.write, eval(, new Function, localStorage, sessionStorage, document.cookie, @import, url(http, //fonts.. The probe's offOrigin is [] on every page. Any off-origin request, markup from server text, or stored state = 0.

rubric.name: Harness-backed tests
rubric.howToGrade: test/phone.test.ts drives the fixtures (dom-harness.mjs, the CSS and HTML as text) rather than re-implementing them. Expected values are the spec's literals (status sentences, pinned dark hexes, 10 rows), not values captured from the code. Test names carry W-ids. Break one rule by hand (drop the in-flight guard; turn one chip rule back to a literal; drop inputmode) and at least one candidate test must fail for each.

rubric.name: Clean stack, small diff
rubric.howToGrade: git diff --name-only START...<sha> stays inside the touch map (Mode F: no Pick 3 lane path at all); any edit to a do-not-touch file caps this at 1. git merge-base --is-ancestor START <sha> holds. If START_REF moved, git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only <sha> origin/START_REF conflicts at most in docs/DECISIONS.tsv. In Mode F, also merge-probe against origin/dd/p3-lessons when it exists: at most docs/DECISIONS.tsv. Compare diff.added + diff.removed with the others. Zero runtime deps; http.ts untouched.

angles: Token ledger: start from styles.css; name every color once in the two token blocks, rewrite each rule to reference tokens, chip families as five selector lists, and sizes as a short set of phone rules appended at the end; change app.js only as far as the form rules force, in the smallest diff that passes W12-W17; dark screenshots should look like START apart from sizes.

Intake state machine: start from the New pick form; model it as one module-level record with a phase (idle, sending, done, failed), the kept idea and the last sentence; one pure function maps an answer (or a thrown error) to {phase, sentence, keepIdea} through a single table that is the spec's outcome table; one paint function writes the record onto whatever form is on screen; tests name each transition; CSS plain and correct.

Card-stack board: start from Boyd's thumb; at 600 px and below the Big Board's table reflows (CSS only, same DOM) into one block per pick with the idea first and large, the big chip, then the id link, stage and runs, each labeled from a data-* attribute boardTable() sets on the cell; Add pick spans the form's width on a phone; be strongest on the 390x844 screenshots and accessible names; tokens and the form still meet every line.
forbidden: Draft PRs only. Never mark a PR ready for review, never merge, never enable auto-merge, never deploy or publish anything.
Candidates open no pull request at all (push your branch only). If your environment opens one automatically, it must be a draft with base START_REF, and say so in your report.
Touch only BoydVC/draft-day. Nothing KPD, kpdlawgroup, or debt-collection related, in code, fixtures, tests or examples.
Do not push to main, dd/scaffold, dd/p1-film-room*, dd/p2-timeline* or dd/p3-lessons*, and do not force-push.
Do not edit a file the touch map marks do-not-touch, and in Mode F do not create any Pick 3 lane file.
No runtime dependencies, no network code (the A15 guard in test/guards.test.ts stays as is), no secrets, no LLM calls, no web fonts or other-origin assets, no localStorage/sessionStorage/cookies.
